provisional_analysis.attempts: This clip contains one continuous filming take (0.0s–12.97s, cl_01, cl_02) of a single post-laying cleaning stage on a low L-shaped rat-trap bond brick wall (ent_wall). At the very start (0.0s–1.1s, ve_01, cl_01), a first worker (ent_worker_1) lifts a metal mortar pan and trowel (ent_pan_trowel) out of the foreground to clear the camera's view. Immediately afterward (0.8s–12.97s, ve_02, cl_02), a second worker (ent_worker_2) uses a natural bristle broom (ent_broom) in one continuous workflow consisting of three brushing phases: (1) sweeping the vertical side face from right to front-left corner (0.8s–3.6s, cl_03), (2) sweeping horizontally along the top course and corner after a spoken prompt (3.7s–9.4s, cl_04), and (3) sweeping downward along the vertical side face again to clear fallen crumbs (9.5s–12.0s, cl_05) before lifting the broom away (12.0s–12.97s). There are no camera resets or repeated takes of failed actions.
